name: @yottameta/yotta-intel
description: Yuanqing — a zero-dependency threat-intel IOC extraction & normalization engine for AI agents: extracts IP (IPv4/IPv6), domains, URLs, emails, hashes (MD5/SHA1/SHA256/SHA512) and CVE IDs from threat reports, phishing emails and logs; recognizes and reverses defanged forms (hxxp / [.] / (.) / [dot] / [:] / [@]); deduplicates, normalizes (IDN punycode, default-port stripping) and outputs CSV / JSON / STIX-lite (STIX 2.1 Bundle) with the pure Python 3.8+ standard library. Triggers when the user provides text containing suspicious IPs / domains / URLs / hashes and needs IOC extraction, normalization, dedup, format conversion, or safe sharing. Boundaries: fully local and offline; no reputation lookups, no sample downloads, no proactive scanning; authorized / own-asset / educational use only.
